svg.title: Universal Chat / VEGA / Octobot: single-agent architecture
svg.desc: Operations user, Live VEGA Chat and Chat BFF connect to one Universal Chat agent. The agent calls one Asset Services tool and three Transaction Management tools through the MCP server. Authenticated custody access uses API Management. Governed model access uses R2D2 and Vertex AI. Response controls include one final JSON object, summary-first output, compact or full evidence, and zero-time date display.
svg.text: Once per tool / turn | No agent retries | One page, max 50 rows
per table; every source row kept
No guessed values or status meaning
